title: Structural Engineers in Innovation and Entrepreneurship
content:
Structural Engineers in Innovation and Entrepreneurship

    Organizing Department Name: Institutions Innovation Council (IIC)   Title of the event: Structural Engineers in Innovation and Entrepreneurship Date: 23-12-2020 Venue: Through MS Teams Event Description: ATME College of Engineering, Mysuru has organized a webinar on the topic “Structural Engineers in Innovation and Entrepreneurship” in association with Institutions Innovation Council on 23rd December 2020. Dr. Raghavendra Prasad M D, Founder & Managing Director, RPV Engineering Consultants Pvt Ltd shared his thoughts on how structural engineers can engage themselves in innovation and entrepreneurship activities with the students of the institution.
